gap: Credit Cards are required to reserve your Charters. If you give us 48 hours or more notice, you will be full refunded. Within 48 hours there with be a 50% charge, and in you cancel within 24 hours of your charter, or no-show the morning of, you will be charged in full. If Charter is cancelled due to weather, or other unforeseen circumstances, then you will be fully refunded.
blurb: Apex Charters and our 47ft vessel KU’ ULA KAI is one of the largest fishing and most luxurious, private charter boats on Kauai. Complete with A/C, comfortable salon, kitchen, and spacious bathrooms, you will be fishing in comfort.
